tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm archival paper; near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, menus sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table stripes, the empty slot of a binder grid.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not meaning).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; must hold 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Vault teal — the one action colour in every category: primary buttons, links, selected tabs, checked state, the logo's front card. Instance operators may override it (see README).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for `brand` buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active filter chips, focus-within wells. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: foil
tokens.usage: Foil gold — rarity, 'foil/special' markers, the logo's diamond. Fill only; never text on paper.

tokens.name: on-foil
tokens.usage: Text on a `foil` fill.

tokens.name: cat-cards
tokens.usage: Trading card games (MTG, SWU, Lorcana…). Category identity only: tag text, section-header rule, nav dot. Reads as text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `cat-cards-tint`. Never an action or a state.

tokens.name: cat-cards-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a card-game category chip or banner; text on it is `cat-cards` or `ink`.

tokens.name: cat-comics
tokens.usage: Comics and graphic novels. Category identity only, as `cat-cards`. Close in hue to `danger`, so it always appears with its category name and never on a destructive control.

tokens.name: cat-comics-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a comics category chip or banner; text on it is `cat-comics` or `ink`.

tokens.name: cat-other
tokens.usage: Any category without its own accent yet (community-added types). Category identity only. Reads on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `cat-other-tint`.

tokens.name: cat-other-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an uncategorised chip or banner; text on it is `cat-other` or `ink`.

tokens.name: mana-w
tokens.usage: White mana pip fill (`c-mana--w`). Data colour for Magic costs only; never UI. Same in both themes; the pip's `line-strong` outline keeps it visible on any surface.

tokens.name: on-mana-w
tokens.usage: The letter or number on a `mana-w` pip (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: mana-u
tokens.usage: Blue mana pip fill (`c-mana--u`). Data colour for Magic costs only; never UI. Same in both themes; the pip's `line-strong` outline keeps it visible on any surface.

tokens.name: on-mana-u
tokens.usage: The letter or number on a `mana-u` pip (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: mana-b
tokens.usage: Black mana pip fill (`c-mana--b`). Data colour for Magic costs only; never UI. Same in both themes; the pip's `line-strong` outline keeps it visible on any surface.

tokens.name: on-mana-b
tokens.usage: The letter or number on a `mana-b` pip (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: mana-r
tokens.usage: Red mana pip fill (`c-mana--r`). Data colour for Magic costs only; never UI. Same in both themes; the pip's `line-strong` outline keeps it visible on any surface.

tokens.name: on-mana-r
tokens.usage: The letter or number on a `mana-r` pip (≥5.5:1).

tokens.usage: Green mana pip fill (`c-mana--g`). Data colour for Magic costs only; never UI. Same in both themes; the pip's `line-strong` outline keeps it visible on any surface.

tokens.name: on-mana-g
tokens.usage: The letter or number on a `mana-g` pip (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: mana-c
tokens.usage: Colorless and generic mana pip fill (`c-mana--c`). Data colour for Magic costs only; never UI. Same in both themes; the pip's `line-strong` outline keeps it visible on any surface.

tokens.name: on-mana-c
tokens.usage: The letter or number on a `mana-c` pip (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Owned / complete / saved. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Price drift, missing data, needs review. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, 'trade away'. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; grid gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; gutter in the card grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space above page titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, set-code tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, panels.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Collectible images (trading cards): the physical corner, as a percentage of the image width.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card image being hovered or dragged, and an open menu. Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: bp-narrow
tokens.usage: Below this width a collection view switches to its narrow layout (container query on `.c-collection`). Written literally in CSS: custom properties can't be used in queries.
